## Questions, answered

Everything about trials, billing, and what the app actually does.

Can I use the app for free? 

Yes. You get 3 free days to try the app before your subscription starts. You will not be charged during the trial, and you can cancel anytime in your App Store settings.

  When will I be charged? 

You will only be charged after your 3-day free trial ends. Cancel before the trial is over and you will not pay anything. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it.

  How do I cancel my subscription? 

On the App Store: Open the Settings app > Name > Subscriptions > Cancel Subscription.
